propositions: Auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container mid-flight causing the in-flight review to fail-close with vote -1, which blocks the existing backfill reconciler recovery mechanism and requires manual re-trigger

The current shutdown drain window (DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=45) is too short compared to measured review durations (260-911s), causing in-flight reviews to be interrupted and their verdicts fail-closed
Transient GitHub git-fetch hangs (exceeding 300s timeout) trigger review-error conditions that are currently voted as fail-closed -1, making the change invisible to the backfill reconciler

Retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting (leave change vote-less) instead of fail-closing, allowing the backfill reconciler to automatically re-drive the review
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision, the attempt counter should escalate to a fail-closed -1 vote plus CloudWatch alarm rather than deferring indefinitely
The drain and shutdown pattern must include a cancel-scope flag so teardown-mid-review CancelledErrors are treated as retryable no-vote instead of terminal fail-closed verdicts
